python.canonical_lock_role: exact project dependency resolution; used by CI and reproducible setup per README.md Phase-01 environment section
python.note: pyproject.toml's [project].dependencies lists only the project's direct top-level scientific dependencies (jsonschema, PyYAML, wfdb, scikit-learn, joblib, torch, flwr); requirements-dev.lock is the FULL resolved install (including fastapi/uvicorn/httpx/pydantic/matplotlib/etc. pulled in by later tasks). This is expected lock-vs-direct-deps divergence, not a gap: README.md names requirements-dev.lock as the canonical install source, and the clean install from it alone (no direct pip install of fastapi etc. was ever needed) proves there is no undeclared dependency.

frontend.declared_requirement: none pinned (no package.json engines field, no .nvmrc)
